primary_source: Fouvry-Iwaniec, Exponential sums with monomials, JNT 33 (1989), 311-333
raw_remainder_target: o(N^Sigma), with all fixed losses absorbed

theorem1.fixed_h_alternative_at_top: Exponent at least (3/2)*Sigma-1/2, exceeding Sigma for Sigma>1
theorem1.status: No generic power saving at that height; prime sparsity alone has not been analyzed as a new spacing theorem

theorem2.coefficients: arbitrary separate joint coefficients phi_(m1,m2), psi_(m3,m4)
theorem2.fixing_h_and_summing_absolutely: First term exponent eta+(xi+Sigma)/2=1+(3/2)*eta, exceeding Sigma at eta=Sigma-1 and Sigma>1

direct_prime3_fourier.at_H_equal_N: N^2, with an additional logarithmic factor in the printed bound
direct_prime3_fourier.sufficient_target: N^2 times a sufficiently negative power of log N
direct_prime3_fourier.conclusion: The printed bound does not supply the requested comparison

theorem3.coefficients: phi_m separate from arbitrary joint psi_(m1,m2)
theorem3.fixing_h_alternative: Second and third terms require a>=(10/3)*eta and a<=Sigma-4*eta; at top Sigma<=22/19
theorem3.direct_prime_product_status: Inadmissible: each unreworked product-phase exponent is 1

theorem4.direct_prime_product_status: Inadmissible: both unreworked product-phase exponents are 1

theorem5.coefficients: phi_(m1,m2), psi_m3; m4 has unit coefficient
theorem5.proof_hypothesis: Lemma 7 applied with -alpha requires alpha != -1; beta=alpha/(alpha+1)
theorem5.formal_free_h_mapping: m4=h, alpha=-1, m3 one denominator variable
theorem5.direct_prime_product_status: No opposite exponent pair; the free slot cannot be replaced by a prime indicator

scope: These direct mappings and the published unit-coefficient bounds; not every possible use of the paper or its spacing lemmas
